scope: Desktop headless Chromium; real 14 CSS px; not Flutter/Android acceptance

recognizability.automated: Correct Unicode/cmap identities, visible unclipped ink and four distinct glyph rasters.

glyph_observations.U+7F81: The top framed openings are more even/open in the DPR2 after crop. At DPR1 the dense lower structure still relies on very few pixels; the improvement is modest at native size.
glyph_observations.U+87A3: Framed openings and some internal divisions gain visible space at DPR2. At DPR1 the right/central dense structure remains crowded, especially light-on-dark; this is not fully resolved.
glyph_observations.U+6525: The middle counter/short horizontal changes are subtle. DPR2 preserves the overall structure, but DPR1 still has a nearly merged dense center. No strong readability improvement is claimed for this glyph.
glyph_observations.U+9EDB: The central framed area and its separation from adjacent strokes look more open in the DPR2 after crop. DPR1 retains a block-like center; the bottom dots remain present without clipping.

human_review.native_size_conclusion: The four labeled characters retain distinct intended structures. In familiar phrases the intended words can be followed, but the changes are modest at native 14 CSS px. This was a labeled visual inspection, not a blind recognition study. DPR1 still leaves crowded internal strokes, most notably U+6525 and U+87A3.
human_review.pixel_zoom_conclusion: The compact sheet uses original browser glyph-surface pixels with shared before/after bounds plus one CSS pixel of padding, nearest-neighbor x8 at DPR1 and x4 at DPR2. It helps observe pixel changes; it is not a larger-size rendering or evidence of guaranteed readability.
human_review.scope: Only the two Regular WOFF2 files were rendered in the A/B. Hashes for the other current formats record file identity, not equivalent raster behavior. This does not establish every TTF counter improved, all small text is readable, or Flutter/Android acceptance.

historical_fixture_freeze.note: Only the Dense After Regular @font-face URL was redirected to the same-byte historical font. Existing screenshots, original rendering time, measurements, browser results and historical current_font_files are preserved. This is a fixture binding freeze; the historical evidence was not rerun.
